faqs.question: Where is Jharna Clinic & Hospital located in Jashore?
faqs.answer: Jharna Clinic & Hospital is located in Jashore, Khulna Division, Bangladesh. You can view our exact Google Maps location and get turn-by-turn directions using the map section on our website or the Google Maps link provided.

faqs.question: How do I book a doctor appointment?
faqs.answer: You can book an appointment directly through our online appointment form on this website, through our AI Care Assistant chat, or by calling our hospital reception desk. After submission, you will receive a unique tracking ID (e.g., JCH-2026-000123).

faqs.question: Is emergency service available 24 hours a day?
faqs.answer: Yes, Jharna Clinic & Hospital operates a 24/7 Emergency Unit staffed with on-duty medical officers, nursing staff, emergency observation beds, and diagnostic support round the clock.

faqs.question: What diagnostic and laboratory tests are available?
faqs.answer: Our diagnostic wing provides computerized pathology (blood, urine, hormone, biochemistry), digital X-Ray, 4D Color Doppler ultrasonography, and ECG with fast verified reports.

faqs.question: What are the patient visiting hours for inpatient wards?
faqs.answer: General visiting hours are daily from 11:00 AM to 01:00 PM in the morning, and from 05:00 PM to 07:00 PM in the evening. Only one primary attendant is permitted in private cabins outside visiting hours.

faqs.question: Can the online chatbot diagnose my condition or prescribe medication?
faqs.answer: No. The Jharna Care Assistant provides hospital information, doctor schedules, and appointment guidance. It cannot provide clinical diagnoses or prescribe drugs. For acute symptoms, please consult our doctors in person or visit the emergency department immediately.
